request.subject: UNIT:DWARF:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a steam submarine: the hull becomes one closed fat cigar-shaped hull of the same soot-black riveted iron with light grey bands; remove the paddle wheel; the tall smokestack becomes a low round conning tower with a copper hatch wheel and one short copper funnel puffing a little white steam; two round portholes glowing bright green #2bd94a; a small copper propeller at the stern. Keep the size, waterline, thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
